_comment: Rows retired from public/brdp-template-4-2.xlsx and -4-1.xlsx in the "Plantillas 4.1 y 4.2 como ejemplos utiles" round (templates rebuilt with 10 Lufthansa project decisions). Kept here, with their rules as they were, so the tests that exercised these real rules keep doing it.

rows.Title: Use of the element <copyright> and source of copyright information
rows.Definition: Decide whether and how to use the element <copyright>. Any copyright information must be obtained from the relevant authority.
rows.Proposal:
Projects creating their own documentation shall have the copyright incorporated: "Copyright © 2024 by Lufthansa Technik AG.
This document and its content are copyright protected and either owned by or licensed to Lufthansa Technik AG. All rights reserved. This document and the information contained herein shall be kept strictly confidential and shall not be used, disclosed to others or reproduced for any use other than the one they were provided for without the express written consent of Lufthansa Technik AG."
rows.Rule:
<structureObjectRule>
            <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="1">//copyright/copyrightPara/emphasis[1]</objectPath>
            <objectUse>BRDP-S1-00065. Projects with their own documentation must include the Lufthansa Technik AG copyright notice, opening with 'Copyright (C) 2024'. </objectUse>
            <objectValue valueForm="single" valueAllowed="Copyright (C) 2024">Lufthansa Technik copyright emphasis</objectValue>
          </structureObjectRule>

rows.Title: Data module change/revised ratio
rows.Definition: Decide on the threshold that a data module is considered revised rather than changed.
rows.Proposal: Revised shall never be used. All changed data modules shall be marked as "changed" and the corresponding change marks be set.
rows.Rule:
<structureObjectRule>
            <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="0">//@issueType[.='revised']</objectPath>
            <objectUse>BRDP-S1-00053. The issueType attribute must never be set to 'revised' -- all changed data modules are marked 'changed' with change marks; revised is not used. </objectUse>
          </structureObjectRule>

rows.Title: Define security classification values and terms (attribute securityClassification)
rows.Definition: Decide which values to use for the attribute securityClassification and allocate suitable definitions. Refer to Chap 3.9.6.1.
rows.Proposal: BRDP-S1-00012 does not exist in S1000D 4.2. Not to take into account.
rows.Rule:
<nonContextRule>
          <simplePara>This corresponds to BRDP-S1-00012 and it does not exist in S1000D 4.2. Not to take into account. </simplePara>
        </nonContextRule>

rows.Title: Schemas to be used
rows.Definition: Decide which Schemas to be used and in which information set they are to be used.
rows.Proposal: Descriptive, Procedural and IPD schemas shall be used as per Writing Style Guide
rows.Rule:
<structureObjectRule>
                  <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="2">//@xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation</objectPath>
                  <objectUse>BRDP-S1-00006. The applicability cross-reference table schema location should be the flat S1000D 4.2 appliccrossreftable.xsd. </objectUse>
                  <objectValue valueForm="single" valueAllowed="http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-2/xml_schema_flat/appliccrossreftable.xsd">Applicability schema flat 4.2</objectValue>
                  <objectValue valueForm="single" valueAllowed="http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-2/xml_schema_flat/brex.xsd">BREX schema flat 4.2</objectValue>
                  <objectValue valueForm="single" valueAllowed="http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-2/xml_schema_flat/comrep.xsd">CIR schema flat 4.2</objectValue>
                  <objectValue valueForm="single" valueAllowed="http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-2/xml_schema_flat/condcrossreftable.xsd">Condition schema flat 4.2</objectValue>
                  <objectValue valueForm="single" valueAllowed="http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-2/xml_schema_flat/ddn.xsd">DDN schema flat 4.2</objectValue>
                  <objectValue valueForm="single" valueAllowed="http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-2/xml_schema_flat/descript.xsd">Descriptive schema flat 4.2</objectValue>
                  <objectValue valueForm="single" valueAllowed="http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-2/xml_schema_flat/dml.xsd">DML schema flat 4.2</objectValue>
                  <objectValue valueForm="single" valueAllowed="http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-2/xml_schema_flat/fault.xsd">Fault schema flat 4.2</objectValue>
                  <objectValue valueForm="single" valueAllowed="http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-2/xml_schema_flat/ipd.xsd">IPD schema flat 4.2</objectValue>
                  <objectValue valueForm="single" valueAllowed="http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-2/xml_schema_flat/pm.xsd">PM schema flat 4.2</objectValue>
                  <objectValue valueForm="single" valueAllowed="http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-2/xml_schema_flat/prdcrossreftable.xsd">Product schema flat 4.2</objectValue>
                  <objectValue valueForm="single" valueAllowed="http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-2/xml_schema_flat/proced.xsd">Procedural schema flat 4.2</objectValue>
               </structureObjectRule>
<contextRules rulesContext="http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-2/xml_schema_flat/condcrossreftable.xsd">
        <structureObjectRuleGroup>
          <structureObjectRule>
                      <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="0">//dmodule</objectPath>
                      <objectUse>BRDP-S1-00006. Condition cross-reference table data modules must use the Descriptive, Procedural or IPD schema, per the project's schema decision (Writing Style Guide). </objectUse>
                    </structureObjectRule>
        </structureObjectRuleGroup>
      </contextRules>
<contextRules rulesContext="http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-2/xml_schema_flat/fault.xsd">
        <structureObjectRuleGroup>
          <structureObjectRule>
                      <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="0">//dmodule</objectPath>
                      <objectUse>BRDP-S1-00006. Fault data modules must use the Descriptive, Procedural or IPD schema, per the project's schema decision (Writing Style Guide). </objectUse>
                    </structureObjectRule>
        </structureObjectRuleGroup>
      </contextRules>
<contextRules rulesContext="http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-2/xml_schema_flat/prdcrossreftable.xsd">
        <structureObjectRuleGroup>
          <structureObjectRule>
                      <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="0">//dmodule</objectPath>
                      <objectUse>BRDP-S1-00006. Product cross-reference table data modules must use the Descriptive, Procedural or IPD schema, per the project's schema decision (Writing Style Guide). </objectUse>
                    </structureObjectRule>
        </structureObjectRuleGroup>
      </contextRules>

rows.Title: Types of CIR data modules to be used
rows.Definition: Decide which CIR data module types to be used. In order to avoid any redundancy and inconsistency, care must be paid on some types, depending on other project specific decisions, for example tailoring of the S2000M (IPD data modules vs parts CIR data module).
rows.Proposal: CIR concept shall be used for warnings, cautions, tools, enterprise codes, parts (for IPL), supplies
rows.Rule:
<contextRules rulesContext="http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-2/xml_schema_flat/comrep.xsd">
        <structureObjectRuleGroup>
          <structureObjectRule>
                            <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="2">//commonRepository/partRepository</objectPath>
                            <objectUse>BRDP-S1-00377. The Common Information Repository may include a <partRepository> -- CIR is used for parts (IPL). </objectUse>
                         </structureObjectRule>
          <structureObjectRule>
                            <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="2">//commonRepository/toolRepository</objectPath>
                            <objectUse>BRDP-S1-00377. The Common Information Repository may include a <toolRepository> -- CIR is used for tools. </objectUse>
                         </structureObjectRule>
          <structureObjectRule>
                            <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="2">//commonRepository/supplyRepository</objectPath>
                            <objectUse>BRDP-S1-00377. The Common Information Repository may include a <supplyRepository> -- CIR is used for supplies. </objectUse>
                         </structureObjectRule>
          <structureObjectRule>
                            <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="2">//commonRepository/warningRepository</objectPath>
                            <objectUse>BRDP-S1-00377. The Common Information Repository may include a <warningRepository> -- CIR is used for warnings. </objectUse>
                         </structureObjectRule>
          <structureObjectRule>
                            <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="2">//commonRepository/cautionRepository</objectPath>
                            <objectUse>BRDP-S1-00377. The Common Information Repository may include a <cautionRepository> -- CIR is used for cautions. </objectUse>
                         </structureObjectRule>
          <structureObjectRule>
                      <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="2">//commonRepository/enterpriseRepository</objectPath>
                      <objectUse>BRDP-S1-00377. The Common Information Repository may include an <enterpriseRepository> -- CIR is used for enterprise codes. </objectUse>
                    </structureObjectRule>
          <structureObjectRule>
                      <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="0">//commonRepository/supplyRqmtRepository</objectPath>
                      <objectUse>BRDP-S1-00377. The element <supplyRqmtRepository> must not be used in the Common Information Repository -- CIR is scoped to warnings, cautions, tools, enterprise codes, parts and supplies only. </objectUse>
                    </structureObjectRule>
          <structureObjectRule>
                      <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="0">//commonRepository/applicRepository</objectPath>
                      <objectUse>BRDP-S1-00377. The element <applicRepository> must not be used in the Common Information Repository -- CIR is scoped to warnings, cautions, tools, enterprise codes, parts and supplies only. </objectUse>
                    </structureObjectRule>
        </structureObjectRuleGroup>
      </contextRules>

rows.Title: Issue 001 of a data module must have the issue type new
rows.Definition: The first issue of a data module (issue number 001) must have the issue type new.
rows.Proposal: Issue 001 of a data module shall have the issue type new.
rows.Rule:
<structureObjectRule>
                  <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="2">//dmodule[child::identAndStatusSection[child::dmAddress[child::dmIdent[child::issueInfo[attribute::issueNumber = "001"]]]]]/identAndStatusSection/dmStatus/@issueType</objectPath>
                  <objectUse>Issue 001 of a data module must have the issue type new. </objectUse>
                  <objectValue valueForm="single" valueAllowed="new">Issue type new</objectValue>
               </structureObjectRule>

rows.Title: RFU must not be used on Issue 001 of a data module, unless it is in work
rows.Definition: RFU must not be used on Issue 001 of a data module, unless it is in work. (S1000D Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1, Para 2.1.1)
rows.Proposal: Per S1000D 4.1's own default BREX (Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1, Para 2.1.1): RFU must not be used on Issue 001 of a data module, unless it is in work.
rows.Rule:
<structureObjectRule>
                  <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="0">//identAndStatusSection/dmAddress/dmIdent/issueInfo[attribute::issueNumber = "001" and attribute::inWork = "00" and ancestor::dmodule[child::identAndStatusSection[child::dmStatus[child::reasonForUpdate]]]]</objectPath>
                  <objectUse>RFU must not be used on Issue 001 of a data module, unless it is in work (Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1, Para 2.1.1). </objectUse>
               </structureObjectRule>

rows.Title: The element /changeInline/ must not be used to indicate that a complete element has been...
rows.Definition: The element /changeInline/ must not be used to indicate that a complete element has been inserted (or modified). (S1000D Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1, Para 2.4.2)
rows.Proposal: Per S1000D 4.1's own default BREX (Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1, Para 2.4.2): The element /changeInline/ must not be used to indicate that a complete element has been inserted (or modified).
rows.Rule:
<structureObjectRule>
                  <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="0">//changeInline[* and not(text()[normalize-space()])]</objectPath>
                  <objectUse>The element /changeInline/ must not be used to indicate that a complete element has been inserted (or modified) (Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1, Para 2.4.2). </objectUse>
               </structureObjectRule>

rows.Title: There must be no cross-references to deleted information in the data module
rows.Definition: There must be no cross-references to deleted information in the data module. (S1000D Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1, Para 2.4.1)
rows.Proposal: Per S1000D 4.1's own default BREX (Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1, Para 2.4.1): There must be no cross-references to deleted information in the data module.
rows.Rule:
<structureObjectRule>
                  <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="0">//internalRef[attribute::internalRefId = //*[attribute::changeType = "delete"]/attribute::id]</objectPath>
                  <objectUse>There must be no cross-references to deleted information in the data module (Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1, Para 2.4.1). </objectUse>
               </structureObjectRule>

rows.Title: No change markers must appear in a data module if the issue type is not changed
rows.Definition: No change markers must appear in a data module if the issue type is not changed. (S1000D Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1, Para 2.1.1)
rows.Proposal: Per S1000D 4.1's own default BREX (Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1, Para 2.1.1): No change markers must appear in a data module if the issue type is not changed.
rows.Rule:
<structureObjectRule>
                  <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="0">//*[attribute::changeMark = "1" and ancestor::dmodule[child::identAndStatusSection[child::dmStatus[attribute::issueType != "changed" and attribute::issueType != "rinstate-changed"]]]]</objectPath>
                  <objectUse>No change markers must appear in a data module if the issue type is not changed (Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1, Para 2.1.1). </objectUse>
               </structureObjectRule>

rows.Title: The element answer must not be used in a CSL
rows.Definition: The element answer must not be used in a CSL. (S1000D Chap 4.5, Para 4.2.6)
rows.Proposal: Per S1000D 4.1's own default BREX (Chap 4.5, Para 4.2.6): The element answer must not be used in a CSL.
rows.Rule:
<contextRules rulesContext="http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-1/xml_schema_flat/dml.xsd">
        <structureObjectRuleGroup>
          <structureObjectRule>
                  <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="0">//dml[descendant-or-self::dmlIdent[child::dmlCode[attribute::dmlType="s"]] and descendant-or-self::dmlEntry[child::answer]]</objectPath>
                  <objectUse>The element answer must not be used in a CSL (Chap 4.5, Para 4.2.6). </objectUse>
               </structureObjectRule>
        </structureObjectRuleGroup>
      </contextRules>

rows.Title: No change markers must appear in a publication module if the issue type is not changed
rows.Definition: No change markers must appear in a publication module if the issue type is not changed. (S1000D Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1, Para 2.1.1)
rows.Proposal: Per S1000D 4.1's own default BREX (Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1, Para 2.1.1): No change markers must appear in a publication module if the issue type is not changed.
rows.Rule:
<contextRules rulesContext="http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-1/xml_schema_flat/pm.xsd">
        <structureObjectRuleGroup>
          <structureObjectRule>
                  <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="0">//*[attribute::changeMark = "1" and ancestor::pm[child::identAndStatusSection[child::pmStatus[attribute::issueType != "changed" and attribute::issueType != "rinstate-changed"]]]]</objectPath>
                  <objectUse>No change markers must appear in a publication module if the issue type is not changed (Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1, Para 2.1.1). </objectUse>
               </structureObjectRule>
        </structureObjectRuleGroup>
      </contextRules>

rows.Title: Only toolSpec, toolIdent, figure
rows.Definition: Only toolSpec, toolIdent, figure, figureIdent, multimedia, multimediaIdent, applicIdent, applicRefIdent, applic, applicRef elements can be used in the Data update file representing the tool CIR. (S1000D Chap 4.13.2.1, Para 2.3.1)
rows.Proposal: Per S1000D 4.1's own default BREX (Chap 4.13.2.1, Para 2.3.1): Only toolSpec, toolIdent, figure, figureIdent, multimedia, multimediaIdent, applicIdent, applicRefIdent, applic, applicRef elements can be used in the Data update file representing the tool CIR.
rows.Rule:
<contextRules rulesContext="http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-1/xml_schema_flat/update.xsd">
        <structureObjectRuleGroup>
          <structureObjectRule>
                  <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="0">/*[descendant::updateCode[attribute::infoCode = "00N"]]//*[self::zoneSpec or self::partSpec or self::circuitBreakerSpec or self::functionalItemSpec or self::accessPointSpec or self::enterpriseSpec or self::supplySpec or self::supplyRqmtSpec or self::functionalPhysicalAreaSpec or self::controlIndicatorSpec or self::applicSpec or self::warningSpec or self::cautionSpec or self::zoneIdent or self::partIdent or self::functionalItemIdent or self::circuitBreakerIdent or self::accessPointIdent or self::enterpriseIdent or self::supplyIdent or self::supplyRqmtIdent or self::functionalPhysicalAreaIdent or self::controlIndicatorIdent or self::applicSpecIdent or self::warningIdent or self::cautionIdent]</objectPath>
                  <objectUse>Only toolSpec, toolIdent, figure, figureIdent, multimedia, multimediaIdent, applicIdent, applicRefIdent, applic, applicRef elements can be used in the Data update file representing the tool CIR (Chap 4.13.2.1, Para 2.3.1). </objectUse>
               </structureObjectRule>
        </structureObjectRuleGroup>
      </contextRules>

rows.Title: A DMRL must not contain comments or other data management lists
rows.Definition: A DMRL must not contain comments or other data management lists. (S1000D Chap 4.5, Para 2.1)
rows.Proposal: Per S1000D 4.1's own default BREX (Chap 4.5, Para 2.1): A DMRL must not contain comments or other data management lists.
rows.Rule:
<contextRules rulesContext="http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-1/xml_schema_flat/dml.xsd">
        <structureObjectRuleGroup>
          <structureObjectRule>
                  <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="0">//dml[(descendant-or-self::dmlIdent[child::dmlCode[attribute::dmlType!="s"]]) and ((descendant-or-self::dmlEntry[child::dmlRef]) or (descendant-or-self::dmlEntry[child::commentRef]))]</objectPath>
                  <objectUse>A DMRL must not contain comments or other data management lists (Chap 4.5, Para 2.1). </objectUse>
               </structureObjectRule>
        </structureObjectRuleGroup>
      </contextRules>

rows.Title: The entity control number given in a DDN must not include the prefix ICN-
rows.Definition: The entity control number given in a DDN must not include the prefix ICN-. (S1000D Chap 4.4, Para 1)
rows.Proposal: Per S1000D 4.1's own default BREX (Chap 4.4, Para 1): The entity control number given in a DDN must not include the prefix ICN-.
rows.Rule:
<contextRules rulesContext="http://www.s1000d.org/S1000D_4-1/xml_schema_flat/ddn.xsd">
        <structureObjectRuleGroup>
          <structureObjectRule>
                  <objectPath allowedObjectFlag="0">//ddn[descendant-or-self::entityControlNumber[contains((.),"ICN-")]]</objectPath>
                  <objectUse>The entity control number given in a DDN must not include the prefix ICN- (Chap 4.4, Para 1). </objectUse>
               </structureObjectRule>
        </structureObjectRuleGroup>
      </contextRules>
